detailed_description: XML to JSON converts pasted XML text into a formatted JSON object in the browser. The tool starts with a sample XML document, parses the input with the browser DOMParser, and converts elements, repeated child elements, text content, and optionally attributes into JSON. Enable Preserve Attributes to include XML attributes as keys prefixed with `@`, then click Convert to refresh the output. Invalid XML is shown as an error message in the output area, and the generated JSON can be copied from the page.
usage_steps: Paste XML into the XML input textarea or edit the sample document.
Choose whether to preserve attributes as `@attribute` keys.
Click Convert to parse the XML and generate formatted JSON.
If the XML is invalid, review the error message in the output textarea.
Copy the generated JSON when you want to reuse it elsewhere.
usage_examples: Convert a small XML API response sample into JSON for inspection.
Check how repeated XML child elements become JSON arrays.
Preserve attributes from an XML snippet while copying the converted output.
Test whether a pasted XML fragment parses before using it in another workflow.
